name: SME San José State University
chapter: Society of Manufacturing Engineers · Student Chapter S192
tagline: SME San José State University (Chapter S192) is a student club dedicated to advancing interest in manufacturing. We connect Spartans with industry through facility tours, career speakers, and hands-on projects, open to every major.
what_we_do: see real production floors and labs across the Bay Area.
hear from engineers about careers in manufacturing and beyond.
get support for projects you want to build outside of class.
meet students who like making things.
mission: Support students who wish to pursue independent projects outside of class.
Provide speaking events to educate students on careers in manufacturing and beyond.
Connect students with Bay Area manufacturers through tours and networking.
about_sme: SME is a professional association that supports the manufacturing industry through education, training, and events. Student chapters give members access to SME resources, networking, and scholarships.
projects_intro: SME San José State University supports members who want to design and build independent projects outside of class. Bring an idea, find teammates, and get guidance from the Project Lead and our faculty advisor.

spartan_signs.summary: A smart LED sign of the SJSU Spartan helmet, plus the production process to make more of them, built by SME members. You switch a sign on or off, set its colors and schedule it from a web page.
how_it_works: The Spartan helmet logo lit by LEDs in three color zones: white, blue and gold. An ESP32-C6 inside each sign runs WLED, an open-source LED controller.
Sign in, add a sign with the code on its sticker, then set brightness, effects, colors and a nightly schedule, share it, or open a support ticket.
Anyone can sign in, not only @sjsu.edu. Owners (a person, a department or a club) can share their sign with others and remove them again.
teams: The ESP32-C6 and the LED electronics. Lead: Branden Adsuara
Automating how the signs are made
spartan_signs.licensing: The Spartan logo is used with SJSU licensing approval, arranged through the club's advisor.
spartan_signs.status: The control-site demo is live but not connected to real hardware yet.
done: San José State University licensing approval
next: Connect the demo to real sign hardware
Document parts list, specs and production steps
details: Licensing: the team got approval to use the logo, through our advisor.
Customers: mostly departments, clubs and schools, plus individual students.
Accounts: open to anyone, not only @sjsu.edu. Owners can share a sign and remove users, and each sign can reset passwords.
spartan_signs.image_alt: Spartan Signs control page: a list of example signs on the left and controls for one sign on the right: brightness, effects, zone colors and a nightly schedule.
spartan_signs.image_caption: Control demo with example signs. Nothing here talks to real hardware yet.

aint_no_waymo.summary: A miniature self-driving diecast car, plus a website that sends it on room-to-room missions on the second floor of the IS building.
aint_no_waymo.status: The website is online as a read-only simulation and 2 of 8 milestones are done. 11 of 37 build tasks are done and 3 are in progress. The car is not built yet.
done: Website online as a read-only simulation
